repos_data.description: Automatic sample-rate switching for Apple Music and Tidal on Mac: lossless and hi-res play bit-perfect up to 192 kHz, no exclusive mode need...
A blazing-fast terminal music player and mpv-based music library browser with fuzzy search, metadata previews, and zero background daemons.

repo_meta_data.description: Free, open-source, surround bit-perfect music player for Mac. Switches your DAC to every track's native format, plays DSD, Dolby Atmos, TrueHD and DTS, renders surround as Spatial Audio on AirPods, and catches fake hi-res files.
